column1: # Reference genomes for the metagenomic simulation.
#   species    = FASTA basename used in the composition tables (…_microbes.txt)
#   taxid      = NCBI taxonomy id ("" = let the resolver fill it)
#   accession  = pinned RefSeq/GenBank assembly ("" = resolve the reference/
#                representative complete genome by species name at download time)
# This table is the reproducibility anchor. Rows with an empty accession are
# resolved by name on first download; run scripts/resolve_accessions.py to
# snapshot the exact accessions back into this file and commit it.
# Yersinia pestis is pinned to strain CO92 (the marquee ancient pathogen, the
# only strain the original aMeta scripts fixed). Homo sapiens is the host used
# for both the endogenous (ancient) and contaminant (modern) gargammel inputs.
